fields.System.Title: RET-203 — Land returned stock in quarantine
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want every returned unit to enter quarantine, so that
nothing goes back on sale before someone has looked at it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any return receipt confirmation, then stock is created in a quarantine location
  • with quarantine status.
  • - Given any code path, then there is no route that creates returned stock as
  • available — enforced in the service layer, not the UI.
  • - Given quarantined return stock, then it is excluded from availability and can never be
  • allocated.
  • - Given the creation, then a movement from VIRT-CUSTOMER is written with a return
  • reason code.
  • - Given quarantined stock with no disposition after a configured period, then it appears
  • on an ageing report.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Returned stock going straight to available ([doc 09 §8.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); quarantine never cleared ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
